loss_factors.name: wake
loss_factors.source: PyWake Gaussian wake (Niayifar & Porté-Agel 2016) on this layout

loss_factors.name: blockage
loss_factors.source: Engineering scaling (array density × Ct, calibrated to the 1–4 % band of Bleeg et al. 2018) — not a published model

loss_factors.name: electrical
loss_factors.source: Typical annual value; the P2 load flow of SB-510 loses 10.2 MW at 510 MW (2.0 % at full load, less averaged over the year)

loss_factors.name: availability
loss_factors.source: Typical planning value (95 % availability); Beiter et al. 2016, NREL/TP-6A20-66579 model it against distance to port

loss_factors.name: environmental
loss_factors.source: Beiter et al. 2016, NREL/TP-6A20-66579 assume 2 % for temperature shutdown, icing, hysteresis and lightning; this default keeps 1 %

uncertainty.name: Wind resource (NEWA model, no measurement)
uncertainty.source: NEWA mean-speed spread 0.54 m/s (Dörenkämper et al. 2020) on 9.57 m/s, × AEP sensitivity 0.98

uncertainty.name: Wake and blockage model
uncertainty.source: 25 % of the modelled loss (Walker et al. 2016, Wind Energy 19:979)

uncertainty.name: Turbine performance (reference power curve)
uncertainty.source: Lee & Fields 2021, Wind Energ. Sci. 6, 311, Table B6, median of the turbine-performance values

uncertainty.name: Plant non-wake losses
uncertainty.source: Lee & Fields 2021, Wind Energ. Sci. 6, 311, Table B6, median of the non-wake plant-performance values
